title: Certificates of Deposit: Which Certificates Can Take a Grace Top-Up Toward the Jumbo Bonus
content:
A grace top-up aimed at the Jumbo Bonus makes sense on Piedmont Crescent Bank's Certificates of Deposit only for a certificate that is still open to grace actions, that will renew into the same tier, and whose tier has both features the top-up relies on. This page states those three requirements.

## Requirements

1. **Grace actions still open.** The record shows the grace period status, and today falls within the tier's grace days, numbering the day after the maturity date as day 1. Once the last grace day has passed, no top-up of this kind can be made, even if the status still reads grace period.
2. **Renewing into the same tier.** When grace ends the certificate will renew into the tier it now holds: its maturity instruction is to renew automatically, and its tier's renewal tier is its own tier.
3. **Tier features.** The tier offers the Jumbo Bonus, and it accepts add-ons during grace.

A certificate failing any one of these receives no top-up.

## Input, judgement, outcome (hypothetical; ten grace days assumed, maturity date 1 October)

| Date | Status | Maturity instruction | Renewal tier same as current tier | Tier offers Jumbo Bonus and grace add-ons | Top-up possible? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6 October | grace period | renew automatically | yes | yes | Yes, as far as these requirements go |
| 11 October | grace period | renew automatically | yes | yes | Yes; day 10 is the last grace day |
| 12 October | grace period | renew automatically | yes | yes | No; grace actions have closed |
| 6 October | grace period | pay out to savings | yes | yes | No; the certificate will not renew |
| 6 October | grace period | renew automatically | no | yes | No; it would renew into another tier |
| 6 October | grace period | renew automatically | yes | no Jumbo Bonus on the tier | No |
